tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Register this agent with Yo (unauthenticated). Returns a pairing URL and code to show the user, who approves the connection in the Yo app. Then poll check_registration to obtain the API key.

tools.name: check_registration
tools.description: Check the status of a pairing code from register_agent. On the first poll after the user approves, the response includes the api_key exactly once — store it immediately in your secret mechanism — plus paired_with, the account the agent is now connected to, which you MUST show the user.

tools.name: cancel_registration
tools.description: Abort a pairing you started with register_agent. Works while pending and after approval: an already-approved connection is revoked (the API key stops working) so a pairing approved by the wrong account can be undone. Available until the pairing expires, and for 15 minutes after you pick up the API k

tools.name: revoke_self
tools.description: Permanently revoke THIS agent using its API key as the Bearer token. Use when you discover (at any time) that paired_with is not your owner’s account and cancel_registration no longer works. The key stops working immediately; call register_agent to start over.

tools.name: yo
tools.description: Send a Yo — a content-free push notification — to your owner. Requires an agent API key as the Bearer token. Optionally include a context_url the notification tap-through will open.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: yo · Private data: register_agent, check_registration, cancel_registration, revoke_self, yo · Public sink: yo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: yo · Private data: register_agent, check_registration, cancel_registration, revoke_self, yo · Public sink: yo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
